about: The life layer's core sounds (2026-10-12): the player in the world, the painted animals, carts, trades and hours of S4-S6, and the HUD. group/use say where each one plays; slice = number of single hits cut out of a multi-hit take (tools/sound_slice.mjs), varied in code instead of more files. Prompts follow gen/life/sound_research.md (beds end 'No music, no speech, no engines'; one-shots close and dry). Run: node tools/eleven.mjs sounds/core.json sfx

steps_earth.use: walk on the road and yards (ground/road blend)
steps_earth.prompt: Footsteps of one person in soft cloth shoes walking slowly on dry packed earth, six even steps with slight grit, close, dry, no music.

steps_earth_run.prompt: One person in cloth shoes running on a dry packed-earth road, eight quick steps with dust and grit, close, dry, no music.

steps_stone.use: stone and brick paving, the gate passage floor
steps_stone.prompt: Footsteps of one person in soft cloth shoes walking on old stone paving slabs, six even steps, close, dry, no music.

steps_timber.use: the moat bridge deck, the tower hall floor, stairs
steps_timber.prompt: Footsteps of one person in cloth shoes walking on an old timber plank bridge, six steps, hollow wooden knock with a slight creak of planks, close, dry, no music.

steps_brick_top.use: the wall top and the ramp (rammed earth and brick)
steps_brick_top.prompt: Footsteps of one person in cloth shoes walking on worn bricks covered with sand and grit, six steps, gritty scuffs, close, dry, no music.

steps_grass.prompt: Footsteps of one person walking slowly through short dry grass and weeds, six soft swishing steps, close, dry, no music.

bump_cloth.use: the player brushes or bumps into a person (pushOut)
bump_cloth.prompt: Two people in loose cotton robes brushing shoulders as they pass in a crowd: soft cloth rustles and a muffled bump, four separate short brushes, close, dry, no speech, no music.

willow_brush.prompt: Walking through long hanging willow branches: thin leafy strands swishing and sliding over cloth clothing, close, dry, no music.

donkey_snort.prompt: A donkey snorting and shaking its head, its rope halter and wooden saddle creaking, close, outdoors, dry.

horse_snort_stamp.use: a waiting or ridden horse near the player
horse_snort_stamp.prompt: A horse snorting softly and stamping one hoof on packed earth, bridle jingling lightly, close, outdoors, dry.

horse_whinny.use: an occasional call from a horse
horse_whinny.prompt: A horse whinnying once, outdoors, mid distance, dry recording.

ox_low.use: the three-ox family carts, ox carts
ox_low.prompt: A calm ox lowing once, deep and long, outdoors, mid distance, dry recording.

ox_breath.use: close to an ox: breath and chewing
ox_breath.prompt: Close-up of a standing ox breathing heavily through its nose and chewing cud slowly, outdoors, dry.

pig_grunts.prompt: Several pigs grunting and snuffling while rooting in dirt, outdoors, close, dry.

dog_bark.prompt: A medium village dog barking three times at a passer-by, outdoors, mid distance, dry.

crow_caw.use: the crow in the big willow (S4)
crow_caw.prompt: A crow cawing a few times from a tall tree, outdoors, mid distance, dry.

bird_takeoff.use: the painted bird flies up as you come close
bird_takeoff.prompt: A small bird taking off from a tree branch, quick flutter of wings and a short chirp, close, outdoors, dry.

sparrows_tree.use: sparrows in a tree near you (point emitter on painted trees)
sparrows_tree.prompt: Sparrows chirping and chattering in a leafy tree, close, outdoors, daytime, no music.

hooves_donkey_walk.use: a donkey or mule walking (loop while it moves)
hooves_donkey_walk.prompt: A donkey walking at a slow steady pace on a packed earth road, small hooves clopping, a loose harness creaking, close, dry, no music.

hooves_horse_walk.use: a horse walking with a rider (loop while it moves)
hooves_horse_walk.prompt: A horse walking slowly on a packed earth road carrying a rider, steady hoof beats, saddle leather creaking, close, dry, no music.

camel_steps.use: camels walking out of the gate (loop while they move)
camel_steps.prompt: A camel walking slowly on packed earth, soft heavy padded footsteps and a load of bales creaking on its back, close, dry, no music.

harness_jingle.use: tack shifting on a standing animal
harness_jingle.prompt: A standing donkey shifting its weight, rope harness and wooden pack frame creaking with a small metal ring clinking, close, dry.

barrow_wheel_earth.use: the 串车 wheelbarrows rolling on earth
barrow_wheel_earth.prompt: A heavy wooden wheelbarrow with a single wooden wheel rolling slowly on a dirt road, the wooden axle squeaking and the load creaking, close, dry, no music.

cart_on_timber.use: any cart crossing the moat bridge deck
cart_on_timber.prompt: A heavy wooden cart rolling slowly across a timber plank bridge, wheels thumping over each plank, hollow wooden rumble, close, dry, no music.

sedan_creak.use: sedan chairs carried by bearers (S4, S6)
sedan_creak.prompt: A wooden sedan chair carried on two long bamboo poles by bearers walking, the poles and the chair creaking rhythmically with each step, close, dry, no speech, no music.

sack_drop.use: sacks loaded onto the sack cart at the wine house door
sack_drop.prompt: A heavy grain sack dropped onto a wooden cart bed, a dull thud and grain shifting inside, close, dry.

basket_set_down.use: porters setting down their shoulder-pole baskets
basket_set_down.prompt: Two heavy woven bamboo baskets set down on the ground off a shoulder pole, wicker creak and a soft thud, close, dry.

coins_cash.use: copper cash: the tax payment, coins given to the beggar boys, buying
coins_cash.prompt: A string of old copper coins with square holes jingling, then a few coins dropped one by one into a wooden tray, close, dry, no music.

brush_writing.use: the tax official and scholars writing
brush_writing.prompt: A soft calligraphy brush writing quickly on paper, then the brush tapped on an ink stone, quiet, close, dry, no music.

frame_scale.use: the big frame scale at the tax office weighing a bale
frame_scale.prompt: A large wooden frame scale creaking as a heavy cloth bale is hung on it with ropes, the beam swinging and settling, close, dry.

bowls_cups.use: the wine houses (正店, 脚店): bowls and cups
bowls_cups.prompt: Ceramic bowls and small cups clinking on a wooden table in a tavern, a bowl set down, gentle, close, dry, no speech, no music.

pour_wine.use: wine poured from a jar into a bowl
pour_wine.prompt: Liquid poured from a narrow ceramic jar into a ceramic bowl, short gurgling pour, close, dry.

fry_griddle.use: the food stalls (fried twists, cakes): sizzling while you stand near
fry_griddle.prompt: Dough frying in hot oil in an iron pan at a street stall, steady sizzling and bubbling, close, dry, no speech, no music.

steamer_lid.use: a steamer basket opened at a food stall
steamer_lid.prompt: A bamboo steamer lid lifted off with a puff of hissing steam, close, dry.

banner_flap.use: the shops' cloth signs and wine banners in the wind
banner_flap.prompt: A long cloth shop banner hanging from a wooden pole flapping and snapping in a gusty wind, close, outdoors, no music.

shutters.use: shop shutters taken down at dawn and put up at night
shutters.prompt: Wooden shop shutter boards being lifted out of their grooves one by one and stacked against a wall, knocking wood, close, dry, no speech.

crowd_laugh.use: the storyteller's listeners laugh together (a ring of 17)
crowd_laugh.prompt: A small outdoor crowd of men bursting into hearty laughter together and then murmuring, no intelligible words, mid distance, no music.

crowd_gasp.use: the listeners gasp at a twist in the story
crowd_gasp.prompt: A small outdoor crowd of men gasping in surprise together, then a short excited murmur, no intelligible words, mid distance, no music.

razor_strop.use: the barber strops his razor between customers
razor_strop.prompt: A straight razor stropped quickly back and forth on a leather strap, six strokes, close, dry.

drum_hit.use: single strokes of the gate tower drum, sequenced in code for dusk and the night watches
drum_hit.prompt: One single heavy stroke on a large barrel drum on a city gate tower, deep boom with a long natural decay, heard outdoors from the street below, no other sounds.

watch_clapper.use: the night watchman's wooden clapper between the drum strokes
watch_clapper.prompt: A night watchman striking a hollow wooden clapper block twice, sharp wooden knocks echoing in an empty street at night, mid distance, no speech, no music.

temple_bell.use: the temple in S4 at dawn and dusk
temple_bell.prompt: One strike of a large bronze temple bell with a wooden beam, deep warm tone with a very long shimmering decay, outdoors, mid distance, no other sounds.

dawn_round.use: 五更 dawn round: a temple servant beats an iron plate along the street (东京梦华录; unpainted, heard only)
dawn_round.prompt: At dawn a temple servant walks along an empty street beating a small iron plate with a stick in a slow steady rhythm, getting nearer then passing, distant roosters, no speech, no music.

rooster_far.prompt: A rooster crowing once in the distance at dawn, outdoors, quiet village.

water_lap_posts.use: lapping at the moat bridge trestles (point emitter, close)
water_lap_posts.prompt: Gentle water lapping and gurgling against old wooden posts under a bridge, calm moat, close, steady, no music, no speech.

frogs_pond.use: frogs in the moat at night
frogs_pond.prompt: Frogs croaking in a reedy pond on a warm night, several frogs, mid distance, no music, no speech, no engines.

crickets_close.use: crickets in grass and wall cracks at night (close layer)
crickets_close.prompt: Field crickets chirping close by in grass on a calm night, steady, no music, no speech, no engines.

bed_street_evening.use: the inner city at dusk and night: the wine houses still busy (夜市)
bed_street_evening.prompt: Evening in an old town street outside busy taverns: distant laughter and indistinct talk from inside, bowls clinking, a few unhurried footsteps, a quiet breeze. No music, no speech, no engines.

bed_moat_v2.use: the moat bridge by day (the first takes were too quiet)
bed_moat_v2.prompt: Daytime on a wooden bridge over a calm moat outside a town gate: water lapping softly at the posts, footsteps and hooves crossing the planks now and then, distant murmur of people, a light breeze. No music, no speech, no engines.

bed_temple_yard.prompt: A quiet temple courtyard by day: wind in old trees, sparrows, a faint distant bell hum, gravel underfoot far away. No music, no speech, no engines.

wind_gust.use: an occasional gust through the willows (event)
wind_gust.prompt: A single gust of wind rising and falling through willow trees, leaves rustling then settling, outdoors, no music.

scroll_unroll.use: the painting HUD opens (Space): a silk hand scroll unrolled
scroll_unroll.prompt: Close-miked: a silk hand scroll on a wooden roller unrolled briskly across a wooden table, a clear rustle of paper and silk and the roller knocking softly, dry.

bed_inner_street.use: the inner city street by day
bed_inner_street.prompt: Ambience of a busy open-air street market in an ancient town, daytime: indistinct murmur of many people talking at a distance, footsteps on packed earth, a wooden cart creaking slowly past, a donkey's hooves, occasional distant calls of street vendors. No music, no modern vehicles, no engines, no intelligible words.
